Login.title: Sign in
Login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
Login.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
Login.error: We couldn't send the link. Please try again in a minute.
Login.linkError: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
